profile.price_basis: Inherited 4/12 CNY-per-million bookkeeping rates are a budget proxy only: they are not actual provider prices, a verified upper bound, or a Credits-to-CNY conversion. Token Plan Credits remain authoritative. The original cumulative budget cap is unchanged; this runner never purchases additional quota automatically.
profile.notes: Requested dated snapshot deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 must be returned exactly; no undocumented alias substitution. Explicit enable_thinking=false. Token bounds are local experiment limits, not asserted provider context specifications. This profile declares the requested visual experiment; actual image support and returned identity must be confirmed during execution. No credentials included.

budget_authorization: Original cumulative 200 CNY authorization is retained; new eight-arm scope requires a separate explicit user approval file.

failure_policy.sample_rejections: 400/413/422 except identified systemic configuration errors become missing
failure_policy.unknown_outcomes: missing, never resend; the original ledger conservatively retains the reservation
failure_policy.retry: only explicit non-quota HTTP 429, at most one technical retry within all existing limits
failure_policy.reset_streak: a successfully processed provider response, including an unparsed answer
failure_policy.operator_resume: explicit one-use stop-event acknowledgement may continue only unfinished samples; prior terminals and money protections remain
failure_policy.accounting: error reservation is a conservative budget charge, not a provider invoice
